nodes.label: PII Encryption
nodes.rationale: Customer PII (name, phone) must be encrypted at rest using AES-256-GCM to comply with security requirements while providing decryption fallback for seed/dev data.

nodes.label: Self-Signed Certificate Handling
nodes.rationale: Force Node.js TLS and Prisma query engine to allow self-signed certificates so they can connect securely to external databases (e.g. Supabase) without rejecting invalid certs during dev/migration.

nodes.label: POS Test Timeout Rationale
nodes.rationale: Set higher timeouts (20s-30s) for remote Supabase connection latency to prevent intermittent test failures.

nodes.label: Dark Mode Only Constraint
nodes.rationale: Defines the system-wide visual design rule requiring a dark base background to prevent eye strain and maintain professional aesthetics at the Durban Butchery rank.

nodes.label: React Native Input Value Setter Override
nodes.rationale: React 16+ overrides the value setter, requiring retrieval of the native HTMLInputElement prototype value setter and dispatching a custom input event to ensure React state updates correctly when characters are programmatically typed.
